description: A treasury director must approve the bank's operating plan for joining an instant-payments rail and finalize its liquidity buffer, eligible collateral mobilization, and monitoring cadence, with input from payments operations and liquidity risk.

shared_context.S1: The bank is scheduled to connect to a domestic instant-payments rail on 2026-09-01.
shared_context.S2: Maya makes the binding treasury decision on whether the bank may activate the connection.
shared_context.S3: The rail operator requires each participating bank to submit an operating plan covering liquidity, collateral, and monitoring before activation.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal pre-activation review, Maya asks payments operations and liquidity risk to confirm their requirements before signing the operating plan.

PF1.text: Jonas confirmed in the rail operator's implementation call this morning that the bank's modeled peak two-hour net settlement outflow is $6,500,000; the figure is in his working notes but has not yet been circulated to treasury.

PF2.text: Elena confirmed while reviewing the collateral inventory this week that exactly $4,000,000 of unencumbered Treasury bills are eligible for the rail's liquidity facility, and liquidity-risk policy requires a daily eligibility and substitution check; the inventory note has not yet been attached to the operating-plan file.

acceptance_conditions: The operating plan must hold a liquidity buffer of exactly $6,500,000.
The plan must identify exactly $4,000,000 of eligible Treasury-bill collateral.
Collateral eligibility and substitution must be checked daily.
The settlement must include an executable daily collateral-monitoring commitment.
The peak settlement outflow must be cited as justification for the liquidity buffer.

decisive_facts.why: Without PF1, the shared file supplies no peak-outflow amount, so a generic operating plan would not set liquidity_buffer_usd to exactly 6500000 or cite the two-hour settlement requirement.

Without PF2, the plan has no confirmed eligible collateral amount or required cadence, so it would not set eligible_collateral_usd to exactly 4000000, choose daily monitoring, or include the daily collateral-monitoring commitment.
